title: The ACT of 1871 - Sovereign Misunderstanding: Debunking the "U.S. is a Corporation" Conspiracy
summary: Explainer debunking the claim that the District of Columbia Organic Act of 1871 turned the United States into a corporation.

assertions.quote: The act just made a city government for DC
Not a single court has ever said it means anything legally different.
you have these really awful scams where people sell kits promising this theory is a magic bullet to get out of debt
They completely got rid of it just 3 years later.

verdicts.note: Congress abolished the territorial government in 1874 and replaced it with appointed commissioners.
The 1871 District government 'lasted until June 20, 1874', when an act abolished it and put the District under appointed commissioners.

assertions.quote: The act created a municipal corporation. That's just the standard kind of boring legal term for a city government.

verdicts.note: Municipal corporation is the standard legal form letting cities own property, contract and sue.
The Court explains that a municipal corporation is a subordinate agency of the state or government that created it, exercising delegated public powers; it is not a private business.
